application.name: TM Player
application.summary: Free, ad-free video & music player with USB/SD support and a private vault
application.desc:
TM Player (Turbo Media Player) is a free, open-source and completely ad-free video and music player for Android, developed by MD. Muklash Mia.
Videos and music are scanned across ALL storage volumes — internal storage, SD card and USB pendrives (OTG).
Features: * PLAYit-style home: list or grid view, month grouping, sort by date, name, size or duration, watch history with one-tap clear * Folders, playlists and search across every volume * Gesture player: brightness / volume / seek swipes, double-tap skip (5–30 s), long-press speed boost, playback speeds 0.25x–4.0x * Screenshot button, HDR Enhance colour boost, picture-in-picture, background play, sleep timer * Music player with albums, artists, folders, playlists and a mini player * Private Vault: PIN + fingerprint lock for your videos, hidden from the gallery * Recycle Bin, Media Manage storage overview and a junk Clean page * Video to MP3/audio converter * Themes: dark/light, six accent colours and your own photo theme * No ads, no tracking, no accounts — your files never leave your phone
TM Player is an original work built on Android's public media APIs. Playback uses your device's built-in codecs.
application.author: MD. Muklash Mia

application.name: TM Sounds
application.summary: No-root sound enhancer with EQ curve, volume boost and per-device memory
application.desc:
TM Sounds is a no-root sound enhancer for Android with a premium dark interface, built only on Android's own public audio APIs.
Features: * Profiles — Flat, Music, Movie, Voice, Bass and Custom, each remembering your own changes * Equalizer, two ways — an interactive frequency-response curve and classic sliders, plus a Band Tuner with 0.1 dB fine steps * Bass, Mid and Treble enhancers, plus a Surround (Virtualizer) control * Volume Boost — real output gain via LoudnessEnhancer (0 to +12 dB) * Volume Leveler — a gentle compressor + limiter via DynamicsProcessing (Android 9+) * Per-device audio memory — remembers your profile and boost for each output: wired headphones, every Bluetooth device, USB and the speaker * Lightweight foreground service, optional auto-start after reboot * No root, no ads, no tracking, no internet permission
Honest limits: the equalizer can only control as many bands as your device's audio hardware offers (commonly 5). A few manufacturers restrict global audio effects. Call echo cannot be fixed by any sound app.
application.author: MD. Muklash Mia
